positive.point: Vanguard's platform is appreciated for being clean and straightforward, making it easy for new investors to set up and manage their portfolios.
The ability to buy specific dollar amounts of funds like VOO, allowing for partial share purchases, is seen as a positive feature for those with limited funds.

negative.point: Users experience difficulty selling fractional shares of ETFs on Vanguard, as the platform only permits whole share sales, causing inconvenience for those wanting to liquidate entire positions.
The inability to set up recurring investments for certain ETFs like SCHD or SGOL on Vanguard is a limitation, prompting some users to consider other brokerages like Fidelity.
Vanguard's app and website have limitations in selecting specific lots for sale using SpecID, causing frustration for users trying to manage their tax implications effectively.
Users are unable to manage existing recurring ETF investments through the Vanguard app, as the interface only allows the creation of new transactions.
